civil-tax.shortDesc: Support during tax audits, appeals and court defense of tax claims.
civil-tax.longDesc: Legal advisory and defense in tax audits, fines, compliance issues and appeal procedures, plus tax planning and structuring.

civil-social.title: Social Security Disputes
civil-social.shortDesc: Legal advice on pensions, social assistance and insurance-related disputes.

arbitration.longDesc: Services covering arbitration agreements, claim preparation and enforcement of arbitral awards across jurisdictions.

mediation.title: Mediation & Alternative Dispute Resolution
